work.description: The encyclical of 15 September 1951 on reciting the Rosary, urging October recitation and above all the family Rosary. The Latin original is in Acta Apostolicae Sedis 43 (1951) 577-582. The Vatican English web text numbers paragraphs 2-21 after an unnumbered opening, the locus system used here.
